messages:
mina: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten up the Optimize toolkit section on prefetch vs KV cache behavior. It includes a short migration note and a sample config for the SDK. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :wave:
raj: thanks — dropping in. quick Q: did you change the default prefetch window? that affects latency numbers in the perf table.
lina: I noticed one dead link in the samples section when I skimmed — points to an old gist. I can patch that in the PR unless you want to own it @mina.
mina: @lina please patch it, thanks. @raj default prefetch is unchanged in runtime (0.5s heuristic) but the doc wording suggested it was higher. I changed wording + added note to call out runtime default and how to override.
ezra: can you paste the SDK snippet you added? want to verify the option name matches the client lib.
mina: sure — snippet in the PR but copying here:```
# python example
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient(prefetch_ms=500, kv_cache=True)
# prefetch_ms: how long to warm KV cache (ms)
# kv_cache: enable prefix/KV cache
```
raj: thank you. small nit: client param is `prefetch_window_ms` in the current SDK on main. we renamed it in the runtime a while ago but SDK still uses the old name. i'll open a tiny runtime-compat PR to add an alias and ping the SDK lead.
lina: link fix PR incoming from me in a sec. will also remove the old gist reference and point to the new samples directory.
mina: awesome. can someone sanity-check the migration paragraph where I recommend the heuristic and show when to switch to explicit batching? it's under the "When to tune prefetch and batching" heading in the PR.
ezra: reading now. my quick take: the guidance is good, but we should add an explicit example for short-seq workloads (<32 tokens) recommending smaller batch sizes and shorter prefetch. also add the micro-benchmark numbers we recently ran (p95 latency delta).
mina: good call — I already summarized the micro-benchmark but i'll add the exact numbers (p50/p95) and a tiny graph (png) in the PR.
raj: once you add the SDK param correction note and the latency numbers i'm +1. can we also add a one-line callout that quantized models may change KV hit-rates? small line, helps set expectations.
lina: link PR merged, CI passed. :white_check_mark:
mina: added numbers + quantization callout + updated SDK param note to reference the alias. pushed.
docs-bot: CI: docs build successful for PR #4321 — 12 warnings (link-check), 0 errors.
raj: gonna do a quick code review now. if clean i'll merge and schedule the release note for tomorrow's docs deploy.
ezra: thanks team, nice tidyup! :smile:
mina: Thanks all. assigning followups in the PR for SDK and runtime owners.
